description: Have LAFU do it: setup services the LAFU team does for you (social sign-in, own SMTP and DNS, domain move, payment setup, shop setup, integration, design change, legal pages, custom work as a quote). area picks the screen (social-login, login-page, smtp, mail, dns, domain-move, payments, shop-setup, integration, apps, design, legal-pages, custom; default custom). Returns the offers with price in cents (EUR, null = quote) and your own LAFU orders and quote requests with status (awaiting_payment, open, done, cancelled) and ticket. Order with oma_lafu_service_order.

area.description: Screen the setup is for; default custom.

locale.description: Language of the service names (default en).

name: oma_lafu_services
title: LAFU setup services
